title: BCC Ruling No. 11-01-1274 — maintenance of a tertiary sewage treatment unit
jurisdiction: Ontario — North Gower; respondent was Rideau Valley Conservation Authority
code_edition: Ontario Building Code, Regulation 403 (as cited; edition label unspecified)

facts.text: The record describes a two-storey, three-bedroom dwelling served by a Class 4 sewage system with a tertiary treatment unit listed in the Code supplement.
The applicant sought to maintain the treatment unit but was not authorized by its manufacturer to service and maintain that unit type.
The cited clause is Division B, Clause 8.9.2.3.(2)(b), addressing authorization of the service provider.
